messages:
ellen: noticing a spike of control-plane 5xxs in us-west. pausing tonight's 22:00 UTC rollout. holding all canaries. :warning:
deploybot: auto: release 'release/2026.03.21' -> PAUSED (incident-detect). canary job canary-9 terminated. previous requeue cleared.
sam: ack. Do we need immediate rollback or just stop rollouts?
elllen: (typo) ellen: stop rollouts for now. no mass rollback yet. we should decide whether to pin the last stable before rescheduling.
nora: strongly recommend pin to v2026.03.14. DB migration in the release is gated but still risky; add migration gate if we reschedule.
ops-oncall: restarted control-plane replica at +6m; errors reduced after ~10m but intermittent 502/503s to internal probes persist. I'd like a 30m quiet window before any canaries.
marco: if we wait, I'll update release notes and coordinate comms. can draft customer-facing blurb.
sam: quick checklist: 1) pin previous stable, 2) observe 30m quiet, 3) update changelog/release notes, 4) ops ack, 5) deploybot requeue. who owns pin?
nora: assigning to me. running: `rbctl pin release/2026.03.14 --reason "us-west control-plane incident hold"` and will comment on the ticket.
elllen: (typo) ellen: @deploybot can you propose next available windows per policy? pref late-night UTC (02:00-04:00).
deploybot: candidate windows for team 'api': ["2026-03-22T02:00:00Z","2026-03-22T03:30:00Z","2026-03-23T02:00:00Z"]. default canary fraction=10%, health_window=15m, require health >=99.5%. auto-fallback to pinned version on regression.
ops-oncall: +1 to 02:00. I'll lower alert thresholds for 2h and keep monitoring ingress tails.
marco: draft release-note: "Release deferred due to transient us-west control-plane errors. Requeue planned; final slot to follow." Will ping legal/comms if customer-facing.
sam: nora paste ticket comment when pin is done.
nora: pin complete. ticket note: "pinned to v2026.03.14 due to us-west control-plane incident; will re-evaluate before requeue."
ops-oncall: quiet period observed at +31m; metrics stable. ready for requeue.
sam: @deploybot schedule the first suggested 02:00 slot and keep canary fraction 10% with auto-rollback on regression.
deploybot: acknowledged. scheduled requeue: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. canary policy applied: fraction=0.10, health_window=15m, rollback_on=regression. notification to #eng-releases will post 30m before slot.
elllen: (typo) ellen: thanks team. creating incident note in #incidents and attaching deploybot schedule. proposing a short retro tomorrow to tighten pre-flight control-plane checks. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all  closing thread once deploybot posts scheduled notification.
deploybot: scheduled notification posted to #eng-releases at 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z with canary PID and rollback hooks."
